name: std::basic_stacktrace<Allocator>::rend, std::basic_stacktrace<Allocator>::crend
intro: Returns a reverse iterator pointing past the last entry of the reversed basic_stacktrace. It corresponds to the iterator preceding the first entry of the original basic_stacktrace. This iterator acts as a placeholder, attempting to dereference it results in undefined behavior.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The end iterator of the reversed basic_stacktrace.
